Significant: question: decide.

g.text: Pass rate on the shared tasks of each task tag, all runs pooled; a task carries several tags. Rows run from B's
biggest lead to A's; the bar joins the two dots in the winner's colour, thick and bold when p < 0.05 (exact McNemar
within the tag). Tags with fewer than 10 tasks come last, faded.
